stories.title: Trump Proposes Military Complex Within Planned Triumphal Arch
stories.summary: President Trump announced plans to convert a proposed triumphal arch near Arlington National Cemetery into a 'top grade Military Complex.' The complex would be equipped to house drones, snipers, and store ammunition, with the changes reportedly requested for national security purposes. A federal court is currently reviewing the legality of the arch project.

stories.title: Ukraine Launches Major Drone Attack on Moscow During Russian Elections
stories.summary: Ukraine has launched over 1,000 drones at Russia, marking the largest drone attack on Moscow to date. The assault coincided with the final day of Russia's parliamentary elections, resulting in at least two fatalities and numerous injuries in the Moscow region. Damage was reported at an oil refinery and a residential building, as local officials confirmed the scale of the attack.

stories.title: Trump Bans Journalists from White House; Barrasso Defends Decision
stories.summary: President Trump announced a ban on journalists from CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from accessing the White House, citing unfavorable coverage. This decision was made effective immediately. Senator John Barrasso stated that the ban does not violate the U.S. Constitution, emphasizing the press's obligation to report fairly.

stories.title: Houthis Claim Missile Attack on Riyadh; Saudi Defense Intercepts
stories.summary: Yemen's Houthi rebels claimed responsibility for targeting sensitive sites in Riyadh with ballistic missiles. The Saudi-led coalition reported that the missile was intercepted and destroyed before it could reach its intended target. This incident marks a significant escalation in the ongoing conflict, with air raid alerts issued for Riyadh for the first time since the recent intensification of hostilities.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran Addresses Gaza Conflict After Macklemore Controversy at Concert
stories.summary: During his first concert since dropping Macklemore for pro-Palestinian comments, Ed Sheeran described the situation in Gaza as 'catastrophic and unjustifiable.' He acknowledged making 'mistakes' regarding the controversy surrounding his opening act. The incident has led to criticism and the withdrawal of several other support acts from the tour, with mixed reactions from concertgoers.

stories.title: Key Elections in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and Berlin Test Chancellor Merz's Leadership
stories.summary: Voters in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and Berlin are participating in regional elections, with the far-right AfD party expected to gain ground. The elections are viewed as a critical test for Chancellor Friedrich Merz, who faces potential political fallout depending on the results. Economic issues are anticipated to play a significant role in influencing voter decisions in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania.

stories.title: Panic and Protests Follow Deaths of Miners in Nigerian Custody
stories.summary: In Nigeria's Minna, 37 suspected illegal goldminers died in a prison cell, prompting panic among survivors who struggled to breathe. Protests erupted in response, leading police to fire teargas and impose an overnight curfew. Armed security forces have been deployed to manage the unrest following the incident, which has drawn significant public outcry.
